1.title: Professional platform
1.desc: Showcase your courses professionally on your own page and start selling immediately with no technical experience.

2.title: Instant collection
2.desc: Your students can pay from anywhere with credit cards or Vodafone Cash securely and easily.

3.title: Regular transfers
3.desc: Transfer your earnings directly to your bank account periodically and securely, with detailed financial reports.

4.title: Unlimited students
4.desc: No limit on the number of students or courses you can add. Your platform's growth is unrestricted.

5.title: Advanced analytics
5.desc: Monitor your courses' performance, student count and sales with detailed reports and accurate statistics.

2.title: Add your services and expertise
2.desc: Upload your recorded courses, digital products, and set up your live sessions and consultation appointments easily.

3.title: Start selling and receive your earnings
3.desc: Share your platform link, accept payments securely through an integrated gateway, and withdraw your earnings to your bank account.
